name: Blood Chugger
body:
“They say blood is thicker than water- I tend to agree.

It also has a kind of milk-shake quality to the flavor.”

Prerequisite(s): Stirgo OR stirgi and Constitution 15

Benefit(s): Your blood drain deals 1d4 Constitution damage.
